value.rationale: Reachable-space ranks and minimum leader numbers for a family of growing repeated-fiber networks are given by a single exact base-graph calculation, including any number of independent inputs and arbitrarily positioned root/tip choices. A controlled remote leaf can actuate every state when the core endpoint is controllable; arbitrary core and positive fiber conductance profiles are allowed. A six-state interior-leader counterexample shows the statement has a meaningful sharp geometrical boundary rather than a vacuous renaming.
